managerLines.voText: Enjoy tonight. We go again next week.

reactions.positive: Roars of delight! Squad cohesion and belief hit top gear.
reactions.neutral: Great high-spirited banter among teammates.
reactions.negative: None—hard to complain after a passionate victory speech.
reactions.mixed: Tremendous energy and enthusiasm for upcoming fixtures.

managerLines.text: We won, but you made heavy weather of it. You must manage the final minutes better.
managerLines.voText: We won, but you made heavy weather of it. You must manage the final minutes better.

managerLines.text: I'm happy with the points, but don't think for a second that was a flawless display.
managerLines.voText: I'm happy with the points, but don't think for a second that was a flawless display.

managerLines.text: Do not let standards drop in training after this, {player}.
managerLines.voText: Do not let standards drop in training after this.

reactions.positive: Perfectionists respect the manager's refusal to accept mediocrity.
reactions.neutral: A slightly muted reaction as the mood is tempered.
reactions.negative: Frustration that a hard-fought win isn't being enjoyed.
reactions.mixed: Keeps feet firmly on the ground, though slightly buzzkilling.

managerLines.text: Sensational performance from every single one of you! Absolutely magnificent!
managerLines.voText: Sensational performance from every single one of you! Absolutely magnificent!

managerLines.text: Take a bow, lads! That was a masterclass and you deserved every bit of it!
managerLines.voText: Take a bow, lads! That was a masterclass and you deserved every bit of it!

managerLines.text: That was an absolute masterclass from you today, {player}.
managerLines.voText: That was an absolute masterclass from you today.

reactions.positive: Euphoric scenes in the dressing room! Morale reaches peak levels.
reactions.neutral: Rapturous applause and smiles across all squad members.
reactions.negative: None—pure unadulterated post-match joy.
reactions.mixed: Universal morale boost across starters and substitutes alike.

managerLines.text: I cannot believe how lucky we got. You were awful despite the scoreline.
managerLines.voText: I cannot believe how lucky we got. You were awful despite the scoreline.

managerLines.text: If you celebrate that sloppy nonsense, you have no standards. Disgraceful finish.
managerLines.voText: If you celebrate that sloppy nonsense, you have no standards. Disgraceful finish.

managerLines.text: {player}, you were sloppy late on. Standards must stay high.
managerLines.voText: you were sloppy late on. Standards must stay high.

reactions.positive: Only the grumpiest veteran agrees.
reactions.neutral: Shocked looks as music gets cut off.
reactions.negative: Fury and resentment—ruining a victory speech creates deep unrest.
reactions.mixed: Dressing room atmosphere turns icy; players feel completely cheated.

managerLines.text: Good win. Ice baths, hydration, nutrition. Our next opponent is already watching tape.
managerLines.voText: Good win. Ice baths, hydration, nutrition. Our next opponent is already watching tape.

managerLines.text: Take the three points, but note the mistakes we got away with. We move on to next week.
managerLines.voText: Take the three points, but note the mistakes we got away with. We move on to next week.

managerLines.text: Recovery starts tonight, {player}. Ice baths first.
managerLines.voText: Recovery starts tonight. Ice baths first.

reactions.positive: Professional, methodical squad culture reinforced.
reactions.neutral: Players nod and begin post-match recovery protocols.
reactions.negative: A little dry for a post-match victory celebration.
reactions.mixed: Solid professional closure to a positive matchday.

managerLines.text: A point gained in a hard-fought contest. Keep your heads up and move forward.
managerLines.voText: A point gained in a hard-fought contest. Keep your heads up and move forward.

managerLines.text: We didn't lose, and in this division every point counts over eighteen rounds.
managerLines.voText: We didn't lose, and in this division every point counts over eighteen rounds.

managerLines.text: {player}, a solid point on the road. Rest up.
managerLines.voText: a solid point on the road. Rest up.

reactions.positive: Squad accepts the pragmatic reality with quiet resilience.
reactions.neutral: Tired players accept the draw constructively.
reactions.negative: Some strikers look frustrated not to have stolen the win.
reactions.mixed: Sensible, balanced response that protects morale.

managerLines.text: We showed heart to hold on, but next time we turn that draw into three points!
managerLines.voText: We showed heart to hold on, but next time we turn that draw into three points!

managerLines.text: That effort proved we can compete with anyone! Keep that hunger burning!
managerLines.voText: That effort proved we can compete with anyone! Keep that hunger burning!

managerLines.text: We dust ourselves down and take three points next time, {player}.
managerLines.voText: We dust ourselves down and take three points next time.

reactions.positive: Spirited encouragement lifts tired legs.
reactions.neutral: Players nod, ready to bounce back with a win next time.
reactions.negative: Some players feel the pep talk masks a missed opportunity.
reactions.mixed: Constructive morale boost that reframes the draw positively.

managerLines.text: Two points dropped against a side we should be beating. Totally unacceptable.
managerLines.voText: Two points dropped against a side we should be beating. Totally unacceptable.

managerLines.text: You lacked the killer instinct to finish them off. We must be more clinical.
managerLines.voText: You lacked the killer instinct to finish them off. We must be more clinical.

managerLines.text: {player}, we should have killed that game off.
managerLines.voText: we should have killed that game off.

reactions.positive: Ambitious players agree and express frustration at the result.
reactions.neutral: Players sit with bowed heads, acknowledging the missed chance.
reactions.negative: Defenders who put in a massive shift feel unfairly blamed.
reactions.mixed: Stings the attackers who missed chances, but fuels determination.

managerLines.text: Tremendous effort out there today against a tough opponent. Proud of the graft.
managerLines.voText: Tremendous effort out there today against a tough opponent. Proud of the graft.

managerLines.text: You gave everything you had on that pitch. No manager can ask for more than that.
managerLines.voText: You gave everything you had on that pitch. No manager can ask for more than that.

managerLines.text: Immense defensive commitment today, {player}.
managerLines.voText: Immense defensive commitment today.

reactions.positive: Players appreciate the acknowledgement after an exhausting afternoon.
reactions.neutral: Tired smiles and pats on the back.
reactions.negative: Ambitious stars feel slightly embarrassed to praise a draw.
reactions.mixed: Warm appreciation across the squad, sustaining morale.

managerLines.text: That was two points thrown away through sheer lack of composure and desire.
managerLines.voText: That was two points thrown away through sheer lack of composure and desire.

managerLines.text: I am bitterly disappointed by what I saw in key moments today. We choked.
managerLines.voText: I am bitterly disappointed by what I saw in key moments today. We choked.

managerLines.text: {player}, that late conceded chance should never have happened.
managerLines.voText: that late conceded chance should never have happened.

reactions.positive: A couple of leaders take it on the chin and resolve to fix it.
reactions.neutral: Heavy, sombre atmosphere settles in.
reactions.negative: Players look resentful after battling hard for ninety minutes.
reactions.mixed: Cuts deep and damages morale, though highlights missed standards.

managerLines.text: We'll review the tape on Tuesday and see where the final pass broke down.
managerLines.voText: We'll review the tape on Tuesday and see where the final pass broke down.

managerLines.text: Small margins decided that draw. Work on our final third execution starts now.
managerLines.voText: Small margins decided that draw. Work on our final third execution starts now.

managerLines.text: We analyze the video on Monday, {player}.
managerLines.voText: We analyze the video on Monday.

reactions.positive: Players appreciate the analytical, objective approach.
reactions.neutral: Heads nod; minds shift to video analysis and training ground fixes.
reactions.negative: A few look too drained for tactical debriefs.
reactions.mixed: Constructive, professional and keeps the squad grounded.

managerLines.text: Tough result to swallow, but we do not unravel. We stick together, learn and bounce back.
managerLines.voText: Tough result to swallow, but we do not unravel. We stick together, learn and bounce back.

managerLines.text: Keep your chins up. One defeat does not define this season. We react on Monday.
managerLines.voText: Keep your chins up. One defeat does not define this season. We react on Monday.

managerLines.text: {player}, keep your chin up. We stick together.
managerLines.voText: keep your chin up. We stick together.

reactions.positive: The squad appreciates the manager shielding them after a loss.
reactions.neutral: A quiet, reflective atmosphere as players take the defeat calmly.
reactions.negative: One or two feel the manager is being too lenient on a bad day.
reactions.mixed: Stops the bleeding and prevents panic after a loss.

managerLines.text: Use this agony! Remember how this feels right now and make sure it never happens again!
managerLines.voText: Use this agony! Remember how this feels right now and make sure it never happens again!

managerLines.text: We are down, but we are not out! We come back twice as hungry next matchday!
managerLines.voText: We are down, but we are not out! We come back twice as hungry next matchday!

managerLines.text: Remember this bitter feeling, {player}. Use it as fuel.
managerLines.voText: Remember this bitter feeling. Use it as fuel.

reactions.positive: Fists clench and eyes narrow—the squad is eager to make amends.
reactions.neutral: Players shake off the sorrow and rally around each other.
reactions.negative: Tired, dejected players struggle to summon the energy to fire back.
reactions.mixed: Replaces sorrow with determination for the vast majority.

managerLines.text: That performance was nowhere near the standard required for this football club.
managerLines.voText: That performance was nowhere near the standard required for this football club.

managerLines.text: I expect an immediate reaction in training this week. Places are on the line.
managerLines.voText: I expect an immediate reaction in training this week. Places are on the line.

managerLines.text: {player}, that level of effort will not be tolerated again.
managerLines.voText: that level of effort will not be tolerated again.

reactions.positive: Proud professionals accept the rebuke and demand better of themselves.
reactions.neutral: Stunned silence in the dressing room.
reactions.negative: Frustration boils over; players feel scapegoated.
reactions.mixed: High tension; puts the squad on alert that sub-par displays have consequences.

managerLines.text: You gave everything you had against a top side. The score didn't do you justice.
managerLines.voText: You gave everything you had against a top side. The score didn't do you justice.

managerLines.text: Hold your heads high. You fought until the final whistle and I'm proud of the effort.
managerLines.voText: Hold your heads high. You fought until the final whistle and I'm proud of the effort.

managerLines.text: You can hold your head high today, {player}.
managerLines.voText: You can hold your head high today.

reactions.positive: Comforting words that lift the heavy weight of defeat.
reactions.neutral: Slightly consoled, though still hurting from the score.
reactions.negative: Some players find it hard to take comfort in defeat.
reactions.mixed: Protects fragile morale, though some would prefer honest critique.

managerLines.text: I am furious with what I just witnessed. You threw that match away with zero heart.
managerLines.voText: I am furious with what I just witnessed. You threw that match away with zero heart.

managerLines.text: You gave up in the second half. That is the one thing I will never tolerate as manager.
managerLines.voText: You gave up in the second half. That is the one thing I will never tolerate as manager.

managerLines.text: {player}, that was completely unacceptable for this football club.
managerLines.voText: that was completely unacceptable for this football club.

reactions.positive: Fiery players burn with embarrassment and want redemption.
reactions.neutral: Heads buried in hands; nobody dares speak.
reactions.negative: Deep dressing room depression; morale hits rock bottom.
reactions.mixed: Brutal wake-up call that stings everyone to the marrow.

managerLines.text: We conceded from simple tactical errors. We go back to basics on the training pitch.
managerLines.voText: We conceded from simple tactical errors. We go back to basics on the training pitch.

managerLines.text: Clear your heads tonight. On Monday, we dissect every goal conceded and fix it.
managerLines.voText: Clear your heads tonight. On Monday, we dissect every goal conceded and fix it.

managerLines.text: Back on the training pitch Monday morning, {player}.
managerLines.voText: Back on the training pitch Monday morning.

reactions.positive: Analytical players appreciate focusing on tangible solutions.
reactions.neutral: Heads nod silently in recognition of the mistakes.
reactions.negative: Some players are too emotionally bruised for technical advice.
reactions.mixed: Provides a clear road map out of the disappointment.
